claim.claim-text: 1. A crystalline maleate salt of Rimeporide, designated as form Succinate-NF1, characterized by a powder X-ray diffraction pattern having one, two, three, four or five peaks at a diffraction angle 2 theta of 12.8° ± 0.2°, 13.9° ± 0.2°, 18.1° ± 0.2°, 18.4° ± 0.2° and/or 23.6° ± 0.2°.

2. A crystalline form of Rimeporide HCl salt, designated as form HCl-A2, characterized by powder X-ray diffraction pattern having three, four or five peaks at a diffraction angle (2 theta, Cu-Kα<1> radiation) of 11.9 ± 0.2°, 14.9° ± 0.2°, 17.7° ± 0.2°, 21.8° ± 0.2° and/or 22.5° ± 0.2°.
3. A crystalline compound according to claim 1 or 2 for use as a medicament.

4. A crystalline compound according to claim 1 or 2 for use in the treatment of a disease selected from muscular dystrophy, myocardial ischemia, reperfusion, cardiac hypertrophy, cancer, nephrotic syndromes, neurodegenerative diseases insulin resistance, diabetes mellitus type 2, metabolic syndrome, pulmonary hypertension, diabetic and/or neuropathy, for the enhancement of insulin sensitivity and the preservation or increase of β-cell compensation diseases being linked thereof.
5. A pharmaceutical composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a crystalline compound according to claim 1 or claim 2.

6. The pharmaceutical composition according to claim 5 further comprising at least one additional compound selected from the group consisting of physiologically acceptable excipients, auxiliaries, adjuvants, diluents, carriers and/or additional pharmaceutically active substances other than the compounds according to claim 1 or 2.

7. Kit comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a crystalline compound according to claim 1 or 2 and/or at least one pharmaceutical composition as claimed in any of claims 5 or 6 and a therapeutically effective amount of at least one further pharmacologically active substance other than the crystalline compound as claimed in claim 1 or 2.
